limitations: Shared host; no parallel independent benchmark groups. Each group deliberately uses multiple workers.
RSS is sampled at 10ms and is a lower bound on peak total live child-process RSS, excluding the Python controller. Rust threads share one process; vanilla uses independent processes.
CPU is summed child process user+system time; wall includes launch, IO and output generation, excludes correctness comparison.
Original batch retains 3 nonfinite cases; model-based batch retains 1. No omitted seeds, changed rounds or parallel throughput inferred from serial speed.
